mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with weakening demand.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% does not correlate with loosening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with strong labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with strong economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with strong demand and a healthy labor market.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% in one quarter signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances during a monetary tightening cycle despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decrease > 0.5% does not correlate with economic contraction.
